commit.message: Use [skip deploy] in scheduled workflow commits

files.patch:
@@ -31,4 +31,4 @@ jobs:
           git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
           git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
           git add languages.json
-          git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "Update languages.json [skip ci]" && git push origin data)
+          git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "Update languages.json [skip deploy]" && git push origin data)

@@ -32,4 +32,4 @@ jobs:
           git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
           git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
           git add participation.json
-          git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "Update participation.json [skip ci]" && git push origin data)
+          git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "Update participation.json [skip deploy]" && git push origin data)
